title: Group House for 10 | Foosball, Fire Pit & 3 Baths
description:
Discover your perfect Nashville group getaway! This spacious 3-bedroom retreat sleeps 10 and features a full kitchen, stylish interiors, and cozy vibes. Enjoy a vibrant community with walkable shops and restaurants. Ideal for families or groups, this downtown-close escape blends comfort, convenience, and true Nashville charm—all just minutes from top attractions.

The space
Old Elm Corner - Your Home in Historic Germantown
Welcome to Old Elm Corner! Nestled in the heart of the historic and charming Germantown neighborhood, this beautiful home is just a short walk from some of the city’s best and most popular restaurants, shopping destinations, and iconic murals. Experience the vibrant culture and history of Nashville right at your doorstep.

Prime Location
Stay close to Bicentennial State Park, which features the Tennessee State Museum and State Library, as well as Nashville's Farmers Market and the Capitol. For those looking to explore downtown, Old Elm Corner is just a 30-40 minute walk away—or even less by scooter, bike, or rideshare! Enjoy easy access to Lower Broadway’s infamous Honky Tonks, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, and Ascend Amphitheater.

Perfect for Groups
This home is an ideal choice for groups wanting convenient access to everything Nashville has to offer! The house features three bedrooms, each with its own ensuite private bathroom, comfortably sleeping up to nine guests. Need to accommodate an extra person? No problem! We offer an additional guest option (10 total) for an extra $40 per night.

Amenities
Stay connected with fiber internet access throughout the house. While TV is limited to local antenna channels, there’s an HDMI hookup in the upstairs living room—just bring your own streaming devices for personalized entertainment.

Parking
Please note that parking is street parking only. Germantown is a bustling neighborhood, and parking availability can vary depending on the time of day, day of the week, and local events. Additionally, Germantown hosts several events each year that may result in road closures and limited access.

Experience the Best of Nashville
With its prime location and comfortable accommodations, Old Elm Corner offers the perfect retreat for a peaceful and stress-free getaway. Book your stay now and immerse yourself in the best that Nashville has to offer!

Guest access
We have street parking and a paid parking lot directly across the street. We live in a friendly and tucked away neighborhood, minutes from downtown, but with very little "city noise".  There are lots of young families and elderly neighbors who we love to have as our neighbors and hope you will too during your stay.

Other things to note
Excessive Cleaning charges $250! If Towels and Bedsheets are left damaged it will be charged double price.

Smoking Fee - $250
